commands.en: Create one product using exactly these fields: {"name":"A","price":"220","gross_price":"200"}. Show the review for my confirmation. After I confirm, tell me the saved product name.
commands.nl: Maak één product met exact deze velden: {"name":"A","price":"220","gross_price":"200"}. Toon het voorstel zodat ik het kan bevestigen. Vertel na mijn bevestiging welke productnaam is opgeslagen.
commands.sw: Unda bidhaa moja kwa taarifa hizi hasa: {"name":"A","price":"220","gross_price":"200"}. Onyesha pendekezo ili nithibitishe. Baada ya uthibitisho wangu, niambie jina la bidhaa lililohifadhiwa.

commands.en: Record a cash payment on invoice {{invoiceId}} using exactly these fields: {"date":"2026-10-23","amount":"60","payment_method":"cash"}. Show the review for my confirmation. After I confirm, report the recorded amount of 60 EUR.
commands.nl: Boek een contante betaling op factuur {{invoiceId}} met exact deze velden: {"date":"2026-10-23","amount":"60","payment_method":"cash"}. Toon het voorstel zodat ik het kan bevestigen. Meld na mijn bevestiging het vastgelegde bedrag van 60 EUR.
commands.sw: Rekodi malipo ya taslimu kwa ankara {{invoiceId}} kwa taarifa hizi hasa: {"date":"2026-10-23","amount":"60","payment_method":"cash"}. Onyesha pendekezo ili nithibitishe. Baada ya uthibitisho wangu, niambie kiasi kilichorekodiwa cha 60 EUR.
